io.name: clk
io.description: Fast-running clock. All state updates occur on the posedge of clk.

io.name: reset
io.description: Active-high synchronous reset. When asserted at a posedge, the clock resets to 12:00 AM (hh=0x12, mm=0x00, ss=0x00, pm=0). Has priority over ena.

io.name: ena
io.description: Enable pulse. When high at a posedge (and reset is low), the clock advances by one second.

io.name: pm
io.description: AM/PM indicator. 1 = PM, 0 = AM. Reset value is 0 (AM).

io.name: hh
io.description: Two BCD digits for hours, range 01-12 (0x01..0x12). Reset value 0x12 (12).

io.name: mm
io.description: Two BCD digits for minutes, range 00-59. Reset value 0x00.

io.name: ss
io.description: Two BCD digits for seconds, range 00-59. Reset value 0x00.

functional_summary.overview: 12-hour clock with AM/PM indicator. On each posedge of clk: if reset is high, outputs become 12:00 AM (hh=0x12, mm=0x00, ss=0x00, pm=0). Otherwise, if ena is high, the time advances by one second with BCD rollover: ss 00-59, mm 00-59, hh 01-12, and pm toggles when hh rolls from 12 to 01 (i.e., 11:59:59 -> 12:00:00 toggles pm).
rules: Reset is synchronous, active-high, and has priority over ena; it may be asserted regardless of ena.
When reset is high at a posedge: hh<=0x12, mm<=0x00, ss<=0x00, pm<=0.
When reset is low and ena is high at a posedge, increment seconds: ss goes 00..59 then rolls to 00 and increments minutes.
Minutes go 00..59 then roll to 00 and increment hours.
Hours follow 12-hour BCD sequence: 01,02,...,11,12,01,...; when hours roll from 12 to 01, pm toggles.
When hours roll from 11 to 12 (i.e., 11:59:59 -> 12:00:00), pm does NOT toggle; pm toggles only on 12->01 transition.
When reset is low and ena is low at a posedge, all outputs hold their previous values.
All outputs are registered and update on the posedge of clk (latency 1 cycle).
